headline: Set Malik Willis as Joe Burrow's AutoSub before Sun 10:00 AM PT kickoff — Burrow (back) was limited at Wednesday's practice with Cincinnati's Week 2 injury report still pending.
summary: Danny is 1-0 and his lineup is already the right one this week, so there are no start/sit changes to make. The one open task is pairing Burrow with Willis before Sunday's early kickoff; Gainwell and A.J. Brown are just status notes, and nothing on waivers — including the heavily-trending Raheim Sanders behind a fully healthy Judkins — clears the bar to touch a full bench.

subs.why: Burrow (Questionable, back soreness) was limited and not full participation at Wednesday's practice with Cincinnati's first Week 2 injury report still pending (Sep 16); set the pair before Sun 10:00 AM PT, Burrow's own kickoff, which is earlier than Willis's Sun 1:25 PM PT game.
